runtime_dependencies.name: @sudocode-ai/cli
runtime_dependencies.reason: Sudocode 0.2.0 resolves better-sqlite3 11.10.0. Its native cleanup abort on Node 24, observed on a GitHub runner on 2026-09-07, no longer reproduces: two consecutive initializations returned 0 on Node 24.21.0 on 2026-09-09. Node 25 and later stay outside the contract until they are probed.

remediations.reason: @nestjs/platform-express pins multer 2.2.0 exactly, in Nest 11 as in Nest 12. Four high-severity denial-of-service advisories apply to <=2.2.0 and are fixed in 2.3.0, same major. The audit gate is not weakened: the vulnerable release is replaced by its corrected one.

The Nest 12 scaffold ships the `nest deploy` helper. Its inquirer -> external-editor -> tmp chain carries two high-severity advisories for which no fixed release exists, so no override can repair it. Build, lint, unit tests, end-to-end tests and the running application do not depend on it.

observations.reason: Node 22.23.2 ships npm 10.9.8, below the 11.19.0 every supported case requires. The previous manifest declared a case that no Node in its own range could satisfy, and its CI reported that as a test failure.

observations.toolchain: Nest 11 or Nest 12 official scaffold, unremediated
observations.reason: Both fail `npm audit --audit-level high` on multer 2.2.0. The declared remediations are required, not optional.
Outside the probed range. The scheduled latest-candidate job reports them without changing this contract.
